one_line: Book in hand and a first-person story, then one comment word in the caption that delivers a real discount.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down hardcover on a table; the cover shows an illustrated girl in a purple cape over a rainbow. Voice from 0:00 (transcript): "אז מה אם הייתי אומרת לך? שאת יכולה להפוך את הילדים שלך לגיבורים" Subtitle from about 0:01.
q1_hook.why: A "what if I told you" question aimed at mothers, over a striking finished cover (H1, H5). A voice from 0:00 and a subtitle within a second (H4, H6). But the subtitle is a small pill, and the idea is complete only around 0:06 (H2, T3).

beats.what: Static top-down hardcover with an illustrated girl in a purple cape; subtitle starts at 0:01
beats.why: The finished product first, with a question

beats.what: Hands with painted nails turn pages: dedication page, a girl in a doorway, a girl in a cloak
beats.why: Real pages and print quality in motion

beats.what: Dissolve to a mother, a boy and a toddler reading on a couch; "כמה שזה ממש דומה לה!!"
beats.why: People and a first-person story replace the product

beats.what: Toddler flips pages; the voice turns to the son: "בכיתה ב' ועובר תהליכים עם עצמו"
beats.why: A second story, but the picture stays on the toddler

beats.what: Adult hands hold the open book; a girl about 5 flips a large book; "שיפור משמעותי בחוויה שלו"
beats.why: A strong claim over footage that does not match it

beats.what: iPhone recording of mebook.ai themes; "פשוט תיכנסו לאתר ותוך כמה דקות", "גם לכם יהיה ספר משלכם"
beats.why: Shows the range of themes and points to the site

beats.what: A girl with the book, then mother and toddler laughing; "הספר האהוב על הילד שלכם"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: a question, "רוצות גם להפתיע את הקטנטנים שלכן בספר אישי ומרגש?", and the comment word "ספר" for a DM code. A line saying it is a moment to share. Nothing in the video.
q2_flow.why: The question-story-pitch line gives a clear arc (K2), and the first 10 s hold the product in hand (R3). The long middle, 0:18 to 0:40, puts a spoken claim over clips that do not match it, so interest can sag (R1, R3). The close lands on a warm image (R4).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and subtitled at 0:40 to 0:44: "פשוט תיכנסו לאתר ותוך כמה דקות" and "גם לכם יהיה ספר משלכם", over the site recording. Caption: write "ספר" in the comments and she DMs a discount code.
q3_cta.why: Two different asks, go to the site in the video and comment a word in the caption (C1). The comment word delivers a real discount, a legitimate conversion route, though the keyword is generic (C3, C2). It is never said or shown in the video (C6).

q4_shown.what: Cover and page flips, the logo on the dedication page, 0:00-0:10; a mother, a boy about 7 to 8 and a toddler reading, 0:10-0:26; a girl about 5 with a large book, 0:26-0:40; an iPhone recording of story themes, 0:40-0:47. No price or photo.
q4_shown.why: A parent's first-hand story and real children with the book are vouching (S6), and the site themes show the range (S8). But the ordering steps are only scrolled past, and "דומה לה" is said with no photo beside the page (S8, S2). Children's faces and a name on the dedication page pair up (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 52.5 s, about 5 s each. Mostly slow dissolves, so the detector saw only 3 cuts, inside the recording; dissolves at 0:10, 0:26, 0:40 and 0:49. No speed changes. Purple-pill subtitles follow a voiceover. Ends on mother and toddler laughing.
q5_edit.why: The first change comes at 2 s (E1). Subtitles are synced to a nearly wall-to-wall voice (E4). At 52 s, with unrelated clips under spoken claims, it runs long for one idea (R1, R3). It ends right after the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's testimonial: a personalised bedtime book excites her toddler, and gave her son about 7 to 8 a confidence boost; a pitch to make your children the heroes.
q6_topic.why: A child's confidence and bedtime reading are real parent concerns (K6), told as a small story (K2). "שיפור משמעותי" in a child's self-esteem is a strong claim resting on one anecdote, not modest (K4). "המתנה הכי שווה" nods to gifting without an occasion (K7).

q7_filmed.what: A static top-down cover on a wooden table; handheld top-down hands turning pages; home clips on a grey couch with a mother, a boy about 7 to 8, a toddler girl, then a girl about 5; an iPhone screen recording over a blurred background. Daylight.
q7_filmed.why: A living room, daylight and real moments look native (H8, F7). Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5). The mother is on camera but does not speak to the lens, as the voice runs over footage (F6). Faces carry the feeling (K8).

q8_text.on_screen: White text in purple pills, 1 to 2 lines, about 78 to 85% down, synced to the voice: "אז מה אם הייתי אומרת לך שאת יכולה להפוך את" (0:01), "כמה שזה ממש דומה לה!!" (0:13), "שיפור משמעותי בחוויה שלו ובערך העצמי שלו" (0:26), "פשוט תיכנסו לאתר ותוך כמה דקות" (0:40), "גם לכם יהיה ספר משלכם" (0:42), "הספר האהוב על הילד שלכם היא בעצם הם עצמם" (0:49). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "הילדים שלי הפכו לגיבורים הראשיים בסיפור קסום שכולו שלהם!". About 100 words: the feeling, a promised discount code, a question, the comment word "ספר", 6 hashtags, the @mebook.ai tag. No disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles carry every spoken line, so it works muted (T1), but they are near-full sentences, small, and inside the bottom 35% (T2, T4, T5). No headline card names the topic (T3). The caption has parent search words, but 6 hashtags and the CTA late (T7). No disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: 52 s for one idea; the same toddler footage under a story about a son; a strong confidence claim with nothing to check; no photo beside the page; two asks; 6 hashtags; no disclosure word.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the cover top-down, hands turning pages with the name page in frame, then a screen recording of the themes; use one comment word that delivers a real offer.
not_verified: Who speaks in the voiceover; whether the children shown are hers or the ones in the story; whether music plays; the discount percentage. The transcript is garbled around 0:17-0:22, so burned-in text is quoted. Corrections to coded file: the subtitle starts about 0:01, and the site recording shows themes such as diapers, pacifier and kindergarten. The cover, dedication and subtitles carry children's names, not quoted. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
